label: FP
reason: User input flows from request parameter NAME (not VALUE) to bar variable. HTTP parameter names are restricted to alphanumeric chars, underscores, hyphens, periods - they CANNOT contain XSS payload characters (<script>, javascript:, onclick, etc.) per RFC specifications. The encoding is defensive but unnecessary since parameter names cannot carry script content.
